children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 17, 2026) - Restart Life Sciences Corp.

(FSE: HN30) (OTC Pink: NMLSF) ("Restart Life" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that BrainBalls™, a line of snack bites developed in collaboration with Brain Balls Inc., has entered the final stages of commercialization. The Company plans to launch BrainBalls™ first in Canada in 2027 and has identified expansion into the United States as a priority for the same year.

BrainBalls™ was introduced in June 2025 under Restart Life's December 2024 joint venture with Brain Balls Inc. Following the launch of Holy Crap Protein+, the Restart Life and Holy Crap Foods teams are applying their product development and distribution expertise to prepare BrainBalls™ for its planned 2027 launch.
To view an enhanced version of this graphic, please visit:

Restart Life intends to introduce BrainBalls™ to Canadian customers through various e-commerce platforms. The Company also plans to use the existing warehousing and logistics capabilities at Holy Crap Foods' facility in Gibsons, British Columbia, to support inventory management, order fulfillment and distribution. The Company referenced the facility and its operating infrastructure in its November 11, 2026 announcement of consumer packaged goods co-packing services.

Restart Life plans to evaluate online marketplaces and distribution options in the United States. Management intends to use early Canadian sales, repeat purchases and fulfillment costs to guide the timing and scope of the U.S. rollout.

"With Holy Crap Protein+, our Restart Life and Holy Crap Foods teams took two products from concept through to commercial launch. We're applying that experience to BrainBalls™," said Steve Loutskou, Chief Executive Officer of Restart Life. "Canada is our planned first market, and expanding into the United States is a priority for 2027. What we learn from the Canadian launch will help us decide which U.S. channels to pursue and how much resources to commit."
Restart Life Sciences thanks its shareholders for their ongoing support as the Company continues to execute its commercialization strategy.
